hero.title: See What’s Underground Before You Dig
hero.sub: We Read the Earth’s Traces — Without Drilling

story.space: The journey begins from space… At 400 kilometers altitude, satellites scan every inch of the Arabian Shield. They capture signals invisible to the eye, revealing secrets buried for millions of years.
story.ground: Then we reach the ground… Qassas Robot climbs rocks, endures +55°C heat, and collects data from every point. It doesn’t tire, it doesn’t err, it doesn’t stop.
story.depths: And finally… we dive into the depths. With laser beams, we read the chemical fingerprint of rocks. We see gold at 300 meters depth. This is not a dream. This is Qassas.

problem.description: Less than 5% of Saudi land has been fully explored. Traditional methods are slow, expensive, and dangerous. Blind drilling fails more than half the time, takes years, and costs millions.

solution.intro: Qassas Robot is a four-legged robot that works independently in the toughest terrains. Designed specifically for the Arabian Shield environment, it climbs rocks, endures extreme heat, collects precise geological data, and transmits it directly via STC 5G network.

sensors.intro: Qassas Robot is equipped with an integrated set of advanced sensors that work together to build a complete picture of the soil and rocks:

satellite.intro: Qassas Robot does not work alone. It connects directly to satellites that monitor the Arabian Shield from 400 km altitude. Satellites identify promising zones, then the robot goes to verify on the ground.
satellite.closing: This system reduces ground travel by 60%, focusing only on high-potential zones — saving time, money, and protecting the environment.

esg.intro: Qassas Robot runs entirely on electric power. Zero emissions. Zero noise. Zero water consumption. It achieves the highest environmental standards and helps mining companies obtain environmental permits faster.

buriedShield.title: The Buried Arabian Shield
buriedShield.content: The Arabian Shield covers a vast area in western Saudi Arabia and contains enormous mineral wealth including gold, copper, lithium, and rare earth elements. However, a large portion of this shield is buried under layers of sand and rock, making traditional exploration extremely difficult. This is where Qassas Robot comes in. Using advanced acoustic imaging technology, the robot can see beneath the surface up to 300 meters deep without drilling. This means we can explore the buried portion of the Arabian Shield and expand the exploration area like never before.

sgs.title: Collaboration with Saudi Geological Survey (SGS)
sgs.content: Qassas Robot contributes to expanding the geological exploration footprint in collaboration with the Saudi Geological Survey (SGS). SGS holds a massive archive of geological data, and Qassas Robot adds new high-precision data from areas that have not yet been explored. This collaboration aims to build a comprehensive national geological database covering the entire Arabian Shield — including buried and remote areas that were previously difficult to access.

vision2030.title: Data Localization Aligned with Vision 2030
vision2030.content: All data collected by Qassas Robot is fully localized within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. No geological data leaves the borders. This aligns with Vision 2030 directives for building a sovereign digital economy and protecting national data. Data is stored in a secure Saudi cloud, processed using locally developed AI algorithms, and shared only with authorized entities within the Kingdom. This ensures full sovereignty over national mineral wealth. All communications run through the national STC 5G network, ensuring fast and secure data transfer without relying on foreign networks.
